title: Clinical outcomes of wavefront-guided laser in situ keratomileusis to treat moderate-to-high astigmatism

license.statement: CC BY-NC 3.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution - Non Commercial (unported, v3.0) License, Dove Medical Press)

indication: simple or compound myopic astigmatism with refractive cylinder 2.0 to 6.0 D and MSE no more than -12.0 D (selection criteria); retrospective noncomparative series

groups.description: primary wavefront-guided LASIK (VISX STAR S4 IR, iDesign profile, iris registration) under a femtosecond flap (iFS, 100-120 um), targeted for emmetropia; 611 eyes of 442 patients

series.notes: mean ± SD [median] (range) cells, the leading mean is read; all 611 eyes at every visit (completion of the 1-week, 1-month and 3-month exams was a selection criterion); some patients contribute both eyes

exclusions.what: t2-opth-9-1291 median and range inside each cell
exclusions.reason: medians and ranges are not admissible (protocol inclusion 4)
proportions and changes between postoperative visits without the preoperative reference (protocol inclusion 4)

exclusions.what: Fig. 2 attempted versus achieved MSE and the proportions within +/-0.50 and +/-1.00 D
t4-opth-9-1291 (vector analysis by preoperative cylinder strata)

exclusions.reason: literature comparison table of other studies

notes: Target: database selection of primary LASIK procedures targeted for emmetropia (plano); a nomogram adjusted the sphere for the aberrometer-derived cylinder.
Analysis set: eyes that completed the 1-week, 1-month and 3-month examinations (attendance-based, not outcome-defined; kept).
Refraction: manifest refraction at follow-up visits (MSE = manifest spherical equivalent); preoperative manifest and cycloplegic refraction were measured, only MSE is tabulated.
The 1-day visit was a slit-lamp examination only.
UDVA, CDVA (logMAR), manifest sphere and cylinder are tabulated (Table 2) and cylinder vector analysis (Table 4); not extracted.
